description: This Java source file contains abstract test cases for the GlobalCommandResponseRegistry component within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It verifies that command response classes are correctly annotated, registered, and present in the classpath, using JUnit tests and class indexing.

classes.name: GlobalCommandResponseRegistryTestCases
classes.description: An abstract test class providing validation methods for command response classes in the Eclipse Ditto framework, ensuring proper annotation and registration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the list of command response classes annotated with @JsonParsableCommandResponse, excluding 'TestCommandResponse'.

methods.name: sampleCheckForCommandResponseFromEachModule
methods.description: JUnit test to verify that all command responses in class index are represented in the sample classes provided.

methods.name: ensureSamplesAreComplete
methods.description: JUnit test to verify that the packages of sample classes include all packages containing command responses.

methods.name: allCommandResponsesRegistered
methods.description: JUnit test to ensure that all concrete subclasses of CommandResponse (excluding acknowledged or special types) are annotated with @JsonParsableCommandResponse.

methods.name: allRegisteredCommandResponsesContainAMethodToParseFromJson
methods.description: JUnit test confirming each JSON-parsable command response class has a method to parse from JSON, as specified by its annotation.
